records.definition: One discrete weapon discharge, rocket launch, mortar/artillery/tank round, shoulder-fired launch, or explosive detonation.
records.boundary: A salvo, mission or exercise may contain many; a reported round allocation is not proof of firing.
records.locator: research/notes/training-tempo-v0.2.md: Scope and counting definitions, firing_event

records.definition: One person's potential presence in one blast-generating event, regardless of who operated the weapon.
records.boundary: Requires person/participation evidence; does not assert measured blast, dose or injury.
records.locator: research/notes/training-tempo-v0.2.md: Scope and counting definitions, exposure_event

records.definition: A tactically grouped sequence of one or more firing events.
records.boundary: Source mission counts do not determine round counts.
records.locator: research/notes/training-tempo-v0.2.md: Scope and counting definitions, firing_mission

records.definition: A continuous or logically grouped training period involving live fire.
records.boundary: Session boundaries must be source-defined; not automatically a day or exercise.
records.locator: research/notes/training-tempo-v0.2.md: Scope and counting definitions, live_fire_session

records.definition: A larger training activity that may contain one or more live-fire sessions.
records.boundary: May also contain dry fire, simulation and nonfiring activity.
records.locator: research/notes/training-tempo-v0.2.md: Scope and counting definitions, training_event

records.definition: A formal qualification or certification requirement spanning one or more tables, sessions or events.
records.boundary: Validity interval and completion requirement do not establish actual live-fire frequency.
records.locator: research/notes/training-tempo-v0.2.md: Scope and counting definitions, qualification_cycle

records.definition: A calendar/training day during which exposure-producing activity occurs.
records.boundary: Exercise duration alone does not count exposure-producing days.
records.locator: research/notes/training-tempo-v0.2.md: Scope and counting definitions, duty_day

records.definition: A Reserve Component or National Guard training period that may contain multiple training events.
records.boundary: The name does not establish its length, firing days, or each person's attendance.
records.locator: research/notes/training-tempo-v0.2.md: Scope and counting definitions, annual_training_period

source_term_mappings.ambiguity: SME period and event boundaries may differ; no multiplication of annual periods by event rockets.
Shooting intention mapped to session; number and boundaries unverified.
Tactical mission wording is not an ammunition or individual-exposure count; no numeric mission count extracted.
Completion requirement is not an observed frequency.
Tables include multiple stages; a table is not one launch or one day.
Exercise duration and unit totals do not identify each participant attendance.
Rotational deployment context exceeds the three-day exercise; the complete rotation is not counted as one firing session.
Crew certification within AT is not the full annual firing inventory.
Reserve training period can contain multiple sessions and qualifications.
